svg.text: This block is replicated 256 times. Everything here is private to one pseudo-channel: its own queue, its own bank state, its own command bus.
row cmd | col cmd | wrdata 256 b | rddata 256 b
Key point: the row and column arbiters run in the SAME cycle on SEPARATE buses. An ACT and a RD can issue together.
